intent.proves: Same inputs produce identical canonical output; first apply reaches it, second apply changes nothing; drift, cross-version references or an unsupported construct refuse before applying. Custom ownership/spec metadata stays in a separate manifest, not ModelVersionSetting keys discarded by an admin settings save.
intent.scope: Exact declared model/version, catalogue and case set on the target with loaded package and assembly hashes; complete observations only. Missing identity, denied access or truncated scope is UNVERIFIED.

bindings.reason: Distribution v1 receipt reader validates independent trust, freshness and scope and preserves failures. No complete domain producer/assertion exists for this intent; the binding stays planned. See references/cpq-observations.md.
